documents.role: Junior Football Coach qualification addendum and deadline extension

notes: Original seven-page advertisement and both corrections are scanned PDFs, transcribed visually; founder confirmation required.

Original notice gives 25 June 2026 at 17:00 for applications. The 24 June addendum, written for post code 02, extends online applications to 30 June at 17:00. Whether that extension covered post code 01 is not explicit; its historical exact cutoff needs review. Both dates have passed as of 25 September 2026.
No formal English proficiency framework is stated. General English is a scored screening-test subject, 50 marks for each post; Coach test is labelled Class XII Level.
Five published examination-centre cities may change with candidate volume. Pins use city-centre precision, not exact venue locations.
Indian citizenship is explicit; Meghalaya permanent residence affects the SC/ST fee discount and some relaxations, not a stated blanket application ban.
